en.title: The AI capital cycle: possible bubble, Big Tech debt and the technical liabilities of accelerated deployment
en.deck: A 360-degree study of the AI investment boom: historical bubbles, 2026 corporate filings, cloud capex, lease commitments, circular credit, GPU depreciation, software technical debt, electricity, productivity and conditional paths through 2030.
en.regime: Real technological adoption amid unprecedented financial commitments, debt-funded capacity, uneven monetization and uncertain technical replacement costs.
en.key_risk: Demand and cash contribution from independent end users may fall short of fixed funding obligations, equipment replacement and secure production-software operation.
watch: Hyperscaler incremental free cash flow after actual capex and lease principal
Uncommenced versus recognized cloud leases and funding costs
AI collateral, neocloud renewals and GPU rental rates by generation
Real productivity and error-adjusted enterprise ROI
Electricity commissioning, water/transformer bottlenecks and public-grid costs
Related-party contracts, repayment maturities and private-credit exposure

pt-BR.title: A possível bolha da IA: dívidas das Big Techs, passivos técnicos e riscos da corrida por infraestrutura
pt-BR.deck: Estudo aprofundado do ciclo de capital da inteligência artificial: bolhas históricas, balanços de 2026, capex de nuvem, arrendamentos, crédito circular, obsolescência de GPUs, débito técnico, eletricidade, produtividade e cenários até 2030.
pt-BR.regime: Adoção tecnológica real com compromissos financeiros excepcionais, capacidade financiada por dívida e monetização e reposição técnica incertas.
pt-BR.key_risk: Margem em caixa de clientes finais independentes pode não cobrir encargos fixos de capital, renovação de equipamentos e operação segura de software produtivo.
watch: Caixa livre incremental após capex e principal de arrendamentos
Contratos futuros versus passivos contabilizados e custo financeiro
Garantias, renovações e aluguel de GPUs por geração
Produtividade real e ROI empresarial ajustado por erros
Energia entregue, transformadores, água e custos públicos
Partes relacionadas, vencimentos e exposição de crédito privado

limitations: Financial data mix current filings, earlier vintages and analyst projections with explicit descriptions; no sum of incompatible stocks and flows.
Private AI firms and nonbank deals have limited disclosure; contingent obligations and counterparty chains remain incompletely measured.
Engineering and productivity studies may have selection and observability biases; no aggregate causal estimate is asserted.
IEA 2030 projection is a scenario, not measured future electricity demand.
contrary_evidence: AI suppliers and cloud divisions report large realized revenue and deployment, inconsistent with zero commercial adoption.
NBER/Stanford find significant AI adoption; DORA finds positive results in disciplined organizations, contrary to universal technical harm.
METR 2025 task-level slowdown does not estimate economy-wide developer productivity in 2026.
Central banks identify financing fragility, but do not establish a systemic default wave today.

producer_checks.information_cutoff: 24 Oct 2026; latest verified Meta Q3 Oct 21, Oracle Sep 10, Microsoft fiscal Jun 30 annual, Google/Amazon Jul, Nvidia Aug, IMF Oct 13, BoE Sep 30, IEA Apr, Stanford 2026 and NBER Oct revision.
producer_checks.editorial_novelty: Cross-layer 2026 AI capital-cycle research joining debt, leases, contractual revenue, physical grids and production software technical debt; distinct from prior general technology abundance signal and macro bulletins.
producer_checks.visual_signature: Two comparable charts (IEA TWh 2025 observed versus 2030 scenario; Meta Q2 Q3 capex) per locale; three substantive tables, causal flow and regional exposure map.
producer_checks.source_check: 32 matched URLs from BIS, IMF, Bank of England, IEA, official investor disclosures (Microsoft, Oracle, Meta, Alphabet, Amazon, Nvidia, CoreWeave), NBER, Stanford, METR, Google DORA, NIST, FTC, independently qualified analyst/observational methods.
producer_checks.bilingual_parity: Matched analytical headings, 32 identical links, quantitative charts and the same historical/accounting/credit/debt technical mechanisms in EN and PT-BR.
producer_checks.methodology: Differentiate realized capex and supplier sales from contract backlog, uncommenced lease liabilities, issued/outstanding debt, equity financing, depreciation and technology maintenance. Counterfactual scenarios not deterministic forecasts.
